thread.title: Boeing, Apple and McDonald's stock rallies account for over 250 Dow points - MarketWatch

author: Tomi Kilgore
title: Boeing, Apple and McDonald's stock rallies account for over 250 Dow points - MarketWatch
text: The Dow Jones Industrial Average's DJIA, +1.12% 277-point gain is almost the entirely fueled by gains in its three earnings reporters, which were adding about a combined 259 points. Boeing's stock BA, +6.51% ran up $25.75, or 7.1%, after blowout results , to add about 175 points to the Dow's price; Apple Inc. shares AAPL, +5.03% shot up $7.39, or 4.8%, after its earnings report out late Tuesday , to add about 50 points; and McDonald's Corp. shares MCD, +2.61% climbed $5.01, or 2.8%, after fourth-quarter earnings to account for about 34 Dow points. In total, 19 of 30 Dow components were gaining ground. The biggest drag was Walmart Inc.'s stock WMT, -2.01% which fell $2.04, or 2.1%, to shave about 14 points off the Dow.
